The Most Powerful Hiking Planner & Navigation App for Confident Adventures. Plan, Map and Tracker with HiiKER.

HiiKER is the best digital toolkit for serious hikers and multi-day trekkers. Our biggest update yet, HiiKER 26, brings a new era of powerful planning and superior mapping to your fingertips.

• Get inspired by over 130,000 hiking trails
• View the world's best topographic maps.
• Plan detailed hiking routes with ease
• Discover millions of hiking focused POIs, places to rest, eat and see.
• Used by Mountain Rescue Teams across the world.

--------------

Navigate with Confidence

Quality Maps on Offer
